text: Await Longchamp review and a possible phone call. Employer gives four weeks from 17 October; review around 14 November if no call is known. No automatic follow-up, rejection, repeat application or email resend. Full letter and portfolio remain available on request.

Wait for POLIPOL review; do not resend the package or send an immediate follow-up. Review status after 22 October if no substantive reply, without automatic contact; a later suitable role requires location, terms, language and permit checks.
